source.rationale: The require-specific numbered picker is rendered by disallowed-entity-gate into escalate_message, and D1 never fires on those turns — which is why the surface stayed bare while D1 annotated the very same codes. Only NUMBERED item lines are touched (the header and the trailing instruction must survive verbatim), a probed code gets has/no and an UNPROBED code stays BARE — never a misleading 'no'. The noun 'certs' normalises to 'certificate' for the customer-facing suffix.
